title: Football Composed Cup
description: Fifteen two-part football questions covering the World Cup, clubs, African football and the laws of the game. Part 2 is worth double points.

questions.question_text: 1. Part 1 — How many players does each team start with on the pitch?
questions.explanation: A football team starts with eleven players, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question_text: 1. Part 2 — How long is a standard football match, not counting added time or extra time?
questions.explanation: A standard match is two halves of 45 minutes.

questions.question_text: 2. Part 1 — Which country has won the FIFA World Cup the most times?
questions.explanation: Brazil has won the men’s World Cup five times, more than any other nation.

questions.question_text: 2. Part 2 — How many FIFA World Cups has Brazil won?
3. Part 1 — Which country hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Qatar hosted the 2022 tournament.

questions.question_text: 3. Part 2 — Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Argentina beat France on penalties in the 2022 final.

questions.question_text: 4. Part 1 — For which national team does Lionel Messi play?
questions.explanation: Messi captains and represents Argentina.

questions.question_text: 4. Part 2 — Which French club did Messi join after leaving Barcelona in 2021?
questions.explanation: Messi moved from Barcelona to Paris Saint-Germain in 2021.

questions.question_text: 5. Part 1 — Which country does Cristiano Ronaldo represent?
questions.explanation: Cristiano Ronaldo plays for Portugal.

questions.question_text: 5. Part 2 — At which English club did Cristiano Ronaldo first become a global star?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo’s first spell at Manchester United, from 2003, made him a worldwide star.

questions.question_text: 6. Part 1 — Which English club is nicknamed the Red Devils?
questions.explanation: Manchester United are known as the Red Devils.

questions.question_text: 6. Part 2 — Which stadium is home to Manchester United?
questions.explanation: Manchester United play at Old Trafford.

questions.question_text: 7. Part 1 — Which club has won the UEFA Champions League / European Cup the most times?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid hold the record for European Cup and Champions League titles.

questions.question_text: 7. Part 2 — Real Madrid’s record European Cup / Champions League total is how many titles?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid’s 15th title came in 2024.

questions.question_text: 8. Part 1 — Which African nation has won the Africa Cup of Nations the most times?
questions.explanation: Egypt have won AFCON seven times.

questions.question_text: 8. Part 2 — Which country won the 2021 Africa Cup of Nations, staged in 2022?
questions.explanation: Senegal beat Egypt on penalties in the 2022 final.

questions.question_text: 9. Part 1 — What is the nickname of Ethiopia’s men’s national football team?
questions.explanation: Ethiopia’s team is nicknamed the Walia Ibex.

questions.question_text: 9. Part 2 — In which Ethiopian city do the Walias often play their home matches?
questions.explanation: Home matches are commonly played in Addis Ababa.

questions.question_text: 10. Part 1 — Which colour card means a player is sent off immediately?
questions.explanation: A straight red card is a sending-off.

questions.question_text: 10. Part 2 — How many yellow cards in the same match lead to a sending-off?
questions.explanation: A second yellow in the same match becomes a red card.

questions.question_text: 11. Part 1 — Which player may handle the ball in open play, but only inside their own penalty area?
questions.explanation: Only the goalkeeper may handle the ball, and only in their own penalty area.

questions.question_text: 11. Part 2 — From how many yards is a penalty kick taken?
questions.explanation: The penalty mark is 12 yards (11 metres) from the goal line.

questions.question_text: 12. Part 1 — How often is the FIFA World Cup held?
questions.explanation: The men’s World Cup is staged every four years.

questions.question_text: 12. Part 2 — How many teams took part in the 2022 FIFA World Cup finals?
questions.explanation: The 2022 finals had 32 teams; the 2026 tournament expands to 48.

questions.question_text: 13. Part 1 — Which player scored the famous “Hand of God” goal at the 1986 World Cup?
questions.explanation: Diego Maradona scored with his hand against England in 1986.

questions.question_text: 13. Part 2 — Against which country did Maradona score that 1986 Hand of God goal?
questions.explanation: The goal came in the quarter-final against England.

questions.question_text: 14. Part 1 — Which country has won the most FIFA Women’s World Cups?
questions.explanation: The United States have won the Women’s World Cup four times.

questions.question_text: 14. Part 2 — Which country won the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup?
questions.explanation: Spain beat England in the 2023 final in Australia and New Zealand.

questions.question_text: 15. Part 1 — Which award is widely seen as world football’s highest individual honour?
questions.explanation: The Ballon d’Or is the best-known individual prize in world football.

questions.question_text: 15. Part 2 — Who has won the Ballon d’Or the most times?
questions.explanation: Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d’Or a record eight times.
